reason: B proposes the more physically plausible mechanism for this Cr-rich, Al-containing alloy—diffusion-enabled partitioning leading to B2 and/or Cr-rich sigma formation—and gives a cleaner quenched-versus-aged comparison with compositional mapping. It still lacks supporting prior evidence and the ~700 °C threshold is insufficiently justified, but A’s lattice-distortion/defect mechanism is not isolated by its experiment and extrapolates HCP/FCC behavior from poorly analogous refractory alloys.
